label: Sloane 3191 — Earliest Surviving Grid
description: The Great Table as Dee first recorded it during the Cracow-period actions (c. 1584). Dictated through Kelley's scrying and written in Dee's own hand. Some cells are difficult to read due to manuscript condition.
provenance: Dee recorded the Great Table in Sloane MS 3191, in his own hand, during the Cracow-period actions. The table was dictated letter by letter through Kelley's scrying. This is the earliest complete surviving copy of the grid.

elementalQuarters.label: Quadrant NW — elemental assignment debated
elementalQuarters.notes: Peterson and Leitch reconstruct Dee's intended elemental assignments differently. The manuscript does not contain explicit element labels on the quadrants.

stateData._dataStatus: PARTIALLY TRANSCRIBED — Quadrant arrangement reconstructed from documented original layout (ORO NW, MOR NE, OIP SW, MPH SE). 5 of 23 known letter differences applied from online sources. Remaining 18 letter changes require consultation of Tyson pp.167-172, James, or Stenwick. Cells with known original-vs-reformed differences marked 'contested' with both readings noted. All other cells inherit Reformed/GD letter data and are marked 'probable' (not 'certain') because the full set of differences is not yet documented.
